raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Investment Banking Analyst with experience in assisting clients with trade Processing & Reconciliation, Mergers, Corporate Actions, NAV Activity, Fund Accounting, and financial reporting. Proficient in handling complex trade activity and reconciliation with Investment Manager v/s Broker. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex financial concepts. Investment Banking Analyst with expertise in conducting due diligence and managing client relationships.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Associate II | State Street July 2022 - Present | ETD DERIVATIVES F&O
Derivatives-Processing and reconciliation (Futures and Options). ● Handling critical merger activity, corporate actions, expiry & assignments. ● Carry out basic and complex trade processing and reconciliation functions in accordance with established procedures. ● Calculating NAV impact to mitigate the risk. ● Supported daily NAV preparation and validation by assessing the impact of trade activity, pricing, cash movements, corporate actions, and reconciliation breaks on fund NAV.
Performed daily cash and position reconciliation between Investment Manager, broker, and internal accounting records, investigating breaks and ensuring resolution prior to NAV finalization.
Managed end-to-end trade settlement activities including trade matching, confirmation/affirmation, settlement monitoring, failed trade investigation, and exception resolution across broker and custody workflows.
Performed daily Fund Accounting activities for assigned funds, including review of fund transactions, cash activity, income, expenses, and investment positions to support accurate NAV preparation.
Perform futures cash activity and manage cash exceptions (TLP). ● Playing vital role in new fund onboarding. ● Processing trades sent by Investment Managers to OTC Hub and MCH. ● Tracking ending cash balances from the broker and booking cash movements. ● Performing reconciliation Investment Manager VS Broker. ● Preparation and delivery of valuation reports to internal and external clients and/or agents in a timely manner. ● ● Reviewing/auditing trades processed by other team members to ensure accuracy. ● Perform and review global pricing tasks in a continuous operations environment. ● Managing query in timely manner ● Cash and Forex posting ● Review and approve pricing packages/checklists with a focus on accuracy & detail. Identify, research and resolve pricing breaking set tolerance levels.
TOOLS & SKILLS
MCH (Multi Currency Horizon) | State Street Cash reporting | Instruct Lite | Bloomberg | OTC Dhub (Reconciliation) | PSAR Cash Reporting | TLM | MFX | Reconciliation | Open Trade Equity | Investment Banking Operations Settlements | Reconciliation Management | Fund Liquidation | ETD Derivatives | Merger | NAV Calculation | Client Communication (Internal & External) | Risk Identification & Mitigation | Deadline Management | Broker Conversion.
raw_sections.education:
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Commerce (Finance) Christ College (Autonomous), University of Calicut | 2022
AWARDS & RECOGNITIONS
Received top rating for performance on consecutive years 2023, 2024. ● Received appreciation from client, governance and higher management. ● Extra Miler Award
